lead: `bun nv proofs --verify --group` reports `perf: never measured` once a new bench exists, and a bench file alone does not close the proof.
body: The gate reads the figure from `docs/perf/members.ndjson`, which only `--record-perf` appends to. Run `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group '<Class>'` after the benches are written, and commit the ledger with them.
